summary: Build a Callaway scoring app with an editable Callaway scoring chart managed via an admin screen hidden behind a settings toggle.

existing_features.title: Add a Settings UI that includes a toggle to enable/disable access to an Admin screen, and persist this toggle across reloads.
Create an Admin screen that is only accessible when the Settings toggle is enabled, and add navigation to reach it when enabled.

Implement a Callaway scoring chart editor within the Admin screen that supports editing both the 9-hole and 18-hole chart rows (gross range bounds, worst holes deducted, and adjustment), with validation and save/reset actions.
Update the app’s Callaway calculation and chart display to use the currently persisted (edited) chart instead of the hard-coded chart, with a safe fallback to the default chart if no edits exist.

new_feature_requests.summary: Add an editable Callaway scoring chart editor accessible from an admin screen, with the admin screen hidden behind a toggle in Settings.

projectName: Add hidden Admin screen with Callaway chart editor (toggle in Settings)
